an5.162:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi
an5.162:1.3: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato sāriputtassa paccassosuṃ.
an5.162:2.1: pañcime āvuso, āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabbo.
an5.162:2.3: idhāvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro.
an5.162:2.5: idha pana āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro hoti parisuddhakāyasamācāro.
an5.162:2.7: idha pana āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ, cetaso pasādaṃ.
an5.162:2.9: idha pana āvuso, ekacco puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ, cetaso pasādaṃ.
an5.162:2.11: idha pana āvuso, ekacco puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro hoti parisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ, cetaso pasādaṃ.
an5.162:3.1: tatrāvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
an5.162:3.2: seyyathāpi āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggahetvā dakkhiṇena pādena vitthāretvā yo tattha sāro taṃ paripāṭetvā ādāya pakkameyya;
an5.162:3.3: evameva kho āvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā. yā ca khvāssa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā, sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:4.1: tatrāvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
an5.162:4.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
an5.162:4.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā ubhohi hatthehi iticitica sevālapaṇakaṃ apabyūhitvā añjalinā pivitvā pakkameyya,
an5.162:4.5: evameva kho āvuso yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhavacīsamācāro parisuddhakāyasamācāro, yāssa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā. yā ca khvāssa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā, sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:5.1: tatrāvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
an5.162:5.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
an5.162:5.6: svāhaṃ añjalinā vā pivissāmi bhājanena vā, khobhessāmīpi taṃ, loḷessāmīpi taṃ, apeyyampi taṃ karissāmi.
an5.162:5.7: yannūnāhaṃ catuguṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyyanti.
an5.162:5.8: so catuguṇḍiko nipatitvā gopītakaṃ pivitvā pakkameyya.
an5.162:5.9: evameva kho āvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro, aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, yāssa aparisuddhakāyasamācāratā, na sāssa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:5.10: yāpissa aparisuddhavacīsamācāratā, na sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā. yaṃ
an5.162:5.11: ca kho so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, tadevassa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ.
an5.162:6.1: tatrāvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
an5.162:6.2: seyyathāpi āvuso, puriso ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno addhānamaggapaṭipanno,
an5.162:6.3: tassa purato pissa dūre gāmo, pacchato pissa dūre gāmo,
an5.162:6.4: so na labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, na labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, na labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, na labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ.
an5.162:6.6: so tasmiṃ purise kāruññaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anuddayaṃ yeva upaṭṭhāpeyya, anukampaṃyeva upaṭṭhāpeyya:
an5.162:6.7: “ahovatāyaṃ puriso labheyya sappāyāni bhojanāni, labheyya sappāyāni bhesajjāni, labheyya patirūpaṃ upaṭṭhākaṃ, labheyya gāmantanāyakaṃ.
an5.162:6.10: evameva kho āvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo aparisuddhakāyasamācāro aparisuddhavacīsamācāro, na ca labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, evarūpepi āvuso, puggale kāruññaṃ eva upaṭṭhāpetabbaṃ, anuddayāyeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā, anukampāyeva upaṭṭhāpetabbā.
an5.162:6.11: “ahovatāyaṃ āyasmā kāyaduccaritaṃ pahāya kāyasucaritaṃ bhāveyya, vacīduccaritaṃ pahāya vacīsucaritaṃ bhāveyya, manoduccaritaṃ pahāya manosucaritaṃ bhāveyya,
an5.162:6.13: māyaṃ āyasmā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjī”ti.
an5.162:7.1: tatrāvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, kathaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo?
an5.162:7.2: seyyathāpi āvuso, pokkharaṇī acchodikā sātodikā sītodikā setakā supatitthā ramaṇīyā nānārukkhehi sañchannā,
an5.162:7.3: atha puriso āgaccheyya ghammābhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito
an5.162:7.4: so taṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhetvā nahātvā ca pivitvā ca paccuttaritvā tattheva rukkhacchāyāya nisīdeyya vā nipajjeyya vā,
an5.162:8.1: evameva kho āvuso, yvāyaṃ puggalo parisuddhakāyasamācāro parisuddhavacīsamācāro, labhati ca kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, yāpissa parisuddhakāyasamācāratā, sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:8.2: yāpissa parisuddhavacīsamācāratā sāpissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbā.
an5.162:8.3: yampi so labhati kālena kālaṃ cetaso vivaraṃ cetaso pasādaṃ, tampissa tasmiṃ samaye manasikātabbaṃ.
an5.162:8.5: samantapāsādikaṃ āvuso puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.
an5.162:9.1: ime kho āvuso pañca āghātapaṭivinayā yattha bhikkhuno uppanno āghāto sabbaso paṭivinetabboti.
